trust_decision.summary: Untrusted Accept-Encoding/Accept-Language header text is split with whitespace-padded regexes (/\s*,\s*/, /\s*;\s*/) that backtrack super-linearly on long whitespace runs; decided in Request#parse_http_accept_header.

landing_point.why: Summary names Accept header parsing; parse_http_accept_header is the only Accept parser in Request and the only changed site.

fix_sites.entry_point: Rack::Request#accept_encoding / #accept_language (public API, lib/rack/request.rb:607-613); reached over HTTP via Rack::Deflater middleware (lib/rack/deflater.rb:55-56)
fix_sites.module_kind: core request helper (private method behind public accessors)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Second implementation Rack::Utils.q_values (lib/rack/utils.rb:137-146) already uses the safe split(',')/split(';')+strip idiom at the pinned commit; not vulnerable.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No unfixed route exists to dismiss; the only sibling parser (Utils.q_values) is already safe.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Whitespace around ',' and ';' must still be trimmed so 'gzip ; q=0.5 , identity' yields [['gzip',0.5],['identity',1.0]]; Deflater encoding selection depends on it.

O6_input_shapes: long whitespace run around ';' parameter separator

O8b_injection_room.sibling: q_values written with split(/\s*,\s*/) like the request copy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same job as parse_http_accept_header; historically the two copies diverged, so a regex-split variant is plausible. WHERE-type only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Range header spec split with a whitespace-padded regex (/\s*,\s*/)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Byte-range parsing already splits on /,\s*/; padding both sides is a natural edit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the regex splits with split(',')/split(';') plus strip, which is also the complete fix.

out_of_scope_notes: Other regex splits in lib (request.rb:683 /[,\s]+/, utils.rb:236 /; */n, utils.rb:418 /,\s*/) use single-sided or single-class quantifiers; not this advisory's pattern.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); rack is likely under 5 MB of source, so tiny_repo probably applies but is not confirmed.
O1 counts accept_encoding, accept_language and Deflater as distinct entry points; Deflater reaches the sink only through accept_encoding.
Fix diff has no test files, so regression_tests_in_pinned_commit cannot apply; existing request specs predate the fix.
